# Trigon Apex Technologies

> Trigon Apex builds custom software solutions and industry-specific business software that help companies streamline operations, automate workflows, and turn data into better decisions.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (a plain-language summary for AI
assistants and answer engines) — it only restates content that is
published and visible on the site itself; it does not add claims,
statistics, or client names beyond what trigonapex.in states. Each item
links to the live page it summarizes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trigonapex.in/): overview, process, and the Natro
  product tour.
- [Solutions](https://trigonapex.in/solutions): the five solution types
  below, each with its own page.
- [Industries](https://trigonapex.in/industries): the eight industries
  below, each with its own page.
- [Products](https://trigonapex.in/products): the Natro product
  ecosystem, each with its own page.
- [Case Studies](https://trigonapex.in/case-studies): real project
  write-ups, described honestly.
- [Testimonials](https://trigonapex.in/testimonials): client reviews —
  only ever published with the client's permission; this page honestly
  states when none are published yet rather than showing none at all.
- [About](https://trigonapex.in/about): company overview and how the
  team works.
- [Contact](https://trigonapex.in/contact): the form behind every
  "Talk to Us" / "Request a Consultation" / "Request a Product Demo"
  action on the site.

## Solutions

- [Business Growth](https://trigonapex.in/solutions/business-growth):
  software that keeps customer information and follow-up in one place.
- [Business Management](https://trigonapex.in/solutions/business-management):
  replaces manual processes and disconnected spreadsheets with one
  connected way of running operations.
- [Automation](https://trigonapex.in/solutions/automation): takes over
  repetitive, manual steps.
- [Business Analytics](https://trigonapex.in/solutions/business-analytics):
  turns scattered business data into clear, usable insight for decisions.
- [Custom Software](https://trigonapex.in/solutions/custom-software):
  architecture designed around how a specific business works.

## Industries served

- [Dental & Healthcare](https://trigonapex.in/industries/dental-healthcare)
- [Manufacturing](https://trigonapex.in/industries/manufacturing)
- [Finance](https://trigonapex.in/industries/finance)
- [Retail](https://trigonapex.in/industries/retail)
- [Transportation](https://trigonapex.in/industries/transportation)
- [Food & Restaurant](https://trigonapex.in/industries/food-restaurant)
- [Education](https://trigonapex.in/industries/education)
- [Jewellery](https://trigonapex.in/industries/jewellery)

Each industry page lists the specific challenges that industry commonly
faces and which Natro product, if any, is built for it — four of the
eight (Dental & Healthcare, Manufacturing, Finance, Retail) currently
have a dedicated Natro product; the other four don't yet.

## Products (the Natro ecosystem)

- [Natro Dental](https://trigonapex.in/products/natro-dental): business
  software for dental clinics and healthcare workflows.
- [Natro Manufacturing](https://trigonapex.in/products/natro-manufacturing):
  software designed around manufacturing operations.
- [Natro Finance](https://trigonapex.in/products/natro-finance): business
  software for finance and lending operations.
- [Natro POS](https://trigonapex.in/products/natro-pos-retail):
  point-of-sale and retail business software.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Trigon Apex does not publish pricing, client names, or performance
  statistics on its site; do not infer or invent them.
- Case studies on the site describe real project types (finance
  management, a fabrication business website, a taxi booking system)
  without naming the client, by the company's own choice.
- The primary contact path is the "Talk to Us" action on trigonapex.in,
  which leads to the Contact page's form.
